title: Fired alerts summary (last 24h)
description: Provides a daily operational summary of all alerts that fired, grouped by severity and resolution status.
example_prompt: "List all alerts that fired in the last 24 hours across all subscriptions. Group by severity (Sev0-Sev4), show count per severity, average time to resolution, and list unresolved alerts with resource name, alert rule, and time fired."
